name: calcora-ai
description: Digital AI Scientific Calculator and mathematics workbench

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vite --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['dist','dist-electron','server.js']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:tutor && npm run test:keyboard && npm run test:service-worker && npm run test:admin-api && npm run test:hygiene && npm run test:encoding && npm run test:client-secrets && npm run test:developer && npm run test:ollama-registry && npm run test:product-knowledge && npm run test:knowledge-grounding && npm run test:phase3 && npx tsx --test src/engine/tests/currencyConverter.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:core && npm run test:keyboard && npm run test:service-worker && npm run test:admin-api && npm run test:hygiene && npm run test:encoding && npm run test:client-secrets && npm run test:tutor && npm run test:tutor-modes && npm run test:tutor-languages && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:pdf-tutor && npm run test:knowledge-grounding && npm run test:tutor-conversation && npm run test:tutor-scoping && npm run test:user-stop && npm run test:math-sse-protocol && npm run test:ai-stream-endpoint && npm run test:ai-stream-client && npm run test:tutor-follow-up && npm run test:tutor-safety && npm run test:private-tutor-routing && npm run test:local-gguf && npm run test:local-model-api && npm run test:gemini-availability && npm run test:gemini-runtime && npm run test:gemini-status && npm run test:intelligence && npm run test:learning && npm run test:multilingual && npm run test:multilingual-input && npm run test:multilingual-adversarial && npm run test:multilingual-response && npm run test:languages && npm run test:math && npm run test:math-100 && npm run test:engine && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:request-security && npm run test:cors-policy && npm run test:speech-input && npm run test:recognition && npm run test:adaptive-learning && npm run test:math-agent && npm run test:adaptive-tutor && npm run test:notebook && npm run test:data-import && npm run test:api-security && npm run test:tutor-guard && npm run test:data-transfer && npm run test:agent-data && npm run test:knowledge-verification && npm run test:verification && npm run test:verification-differential && npm run test:verification-badge && npm run test:live-tutor-verification && npm run test:misconception && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:docx && npm run test:developer && npm run test:ollama-registry && npm run test:product-knowledge && npm run build && npm run test:server-bundle
